muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿المر﴾: The discussion of the disconnected letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.
﴿تلك آيات الكتاب﴾: تلك is a demonstrative, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and آيات الكتاب is the khabar (predicate).
﴿والذي أنزل إليك من ربك الحق﴾: the واو is a conjunction, of the type conjoining clauses to clauses; الذي is a mubtadaʾ; the clause أنزل إليك is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿من ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزل﴾; الحق is the khabar of ﴿الذي﴾.
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يؤمنون﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) that puts its noun in the accusative; أكثر الناس is its noun, and the clause لا يؤمنون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿سواء منكم من أسر القول ومن جهر به﴾: سواء is the advanced khabar (predicate); ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from its pronoun; ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun, the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); or ﴿سواء﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa), and ﴿مَن﴾ is the khabar; the clause أسر القول is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position, i.e. "concealed it within himself"; ﴿ومن جهر به﴾ is conjoined to ﴿من أسر القول﴾.
﴿ومن هو مستخف بالليل وسارب بالنهار﴾: ﴿ومَن﴾ is conjoined to the preceding ﴿مَن﴾; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and مستخف the khabar, and the nominal clause is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿بالليل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مستخف﴾; سارب is conjoined to مستخف; ﴿بالنهار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿سارب﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿له معقبات من بين يديه ومن خلفه يحفظونه من أمر الله﴾: ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); معقبات is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من بين يديه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of معقبات, or attached to معقبات itself; ﴿من خلفه﴾ is conjoined to ﴿من بين يديه﴾; the clause ﴿يحفظونه﴾ is also an adjective of معقبات; ﴿من أمر الله﴾ is attached to ﴿يحفظونه﴾.
﴿إن الله لا يغير ما بقوم حتى يغيروا ما بأنفسهم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يغير﴾ is its khabar; the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يغير﴾ refers back to ﴿الله﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the object of ﴿يغير﴾; ﴿بقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive; يغيروا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by حتى; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يغير﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بأنفسهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وإذا أراد الله بقوم سوءا فلا مرد له﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb for future time, putting its protasis in the genitive, accusative by its apodosis; the clause ﴿أراد الله﴾ is that to which it is annexed (muḍāf ilayhā); ﴿بقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أراد﴾; the فاء is linking; لا is the lā of generic negation; ﴿مرد﴾ is its noun, and ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar.
﴿وما لهم من دونه من وال﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ما is negative; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); وال is genitive in form, nominative by position, because it is the delayed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿هو الذي يريكم البرق خوفا وطمعا وينشئ السحاب الثقال﴾: ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and الذي its khabar (predicate); يريكم البرق is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and its two objects, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿خوفًا وطمعًا﴾ are accusative as maṣdars (verbal nouns), i.e. "that you may fear with fear and hope with hope"; or they are two ḥāls (circumstantials) from the كاف in ﴿يريكم﴾, i.e. "in the state of your being fearful and hopeful"; or from البرق, the implied sense being: "He shows you the lightning as a thing of fear and a thing of hope", or the lightning is made in itself fear and hope by way of hyperbole; or they are two objects of purpose (mafʿūl li-ajlihi); ينشئ السحاب is conjoined; السحاب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الثقال is an adjective (ṣifa) of السحاب.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿ويسبح الرعد بحمده والملائكة من خيفته﴾: conjoined to what has preceded; يسبح الرعد is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بحمده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); الملائكة is conjoined to الرعد; ﴿من خيفته﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يسبح﴾, or attached to something omitted that is accusative as a ḥāl from الملائكة, i.e. "in awe and fear".
﴿ويرسل الصواعق فيصيب بها من يشاء﴾: the واو is a conjunction; يرسل الصواعق is conjoined to what has preceded; فيصيب is also conjoined; ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يصيب﴾; ﴿مَن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يصيب﴾; the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهم يجادلون في الله﴾: the واو is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the واو is for the ḥāl and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يجادلون is the khabar (predicate); ﴿في الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يجادلون﴾.
﴿وهو شديد المحال﴾: the واو is for the ḥāl; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and شديد المحال is its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl clause.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿له دعوة الحق﴾: ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate), and دعوة الحق is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿والذين يدعون من دونه لا يستجيبون لهم بشيء﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; الذين is a mubtadaʾ; the clause يدعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the واو in ﴿يدعون﴾ refers to the unbelievers, and the pronoun returning to الذين is omitted, i.e. "يدعونهم" (they call upon them); the واو in ﴿لا يستجيبون﴾ refers to الذين. It is also said: ﴿الذين﴾ means "the unbelievers who call", and the object of يدعون is omitted, i.e. "they call upon the idols"; the واو in ﴿يدعون﴾ refers to ﴿الذين﴾, and the واو in ﴿لا يستجيبون﴾ refers to the omitted object of يدعون; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿لا يستجيبون﴾ is the khabar; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يستجيبون﴾, and likewise ﴿شيء﴾ [Translator's note: i.e. ﴿بشيء﴾ is likewise attached to ﴿يستجيبون﴾].
﴿إلا كباسط كفيه إلى الماء ليبلغ فاه﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿كباسط﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "except with a response like the response of one who stretches out his hands"; ﴿باسط﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi, and ﴿كفيه﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿إلى الماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿باسط﴾; ﴿ليبلغ﴾: the lām is for giving a reason (taʿlīl); يبلغ is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿باسط﴾; ﴿فاه﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the sign of its accusative being the alif, because it is one of the five nouns; the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يبلغ﴾ is a pronoun referring to ﴿الماء﴾.
﴿وما هو ببالغه﴾: the واو is for the ḥāl; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative particle, operating like ليس; ﴿هو﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿ببالغه﴾: the باء is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿بالغه﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative by position and genitive in form by the باء.
﴿وما دعاء الكافرين إلا في ضلال﴾: the واو is resumptive or for the ḥāl; ما is negative; دعاء الكافرين is a mubtadaʾ; إلا is a particle of restriction; ﴿في ضلال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl clause in the position of accusative.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿ولله يسجد من في السماوات والأرض طوعا وكرها﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسجد﴾; ﴿مَن﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of يسجد; ﴿في السماوات والأرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of مَن, with no grammatical position; طوعًا and كرهًا are accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "willing and unwilling", or as maṣdars (verbal nouns), i.e. "a submission of willingness and a submission of unwillingness".
﴿وظلالهم بالغدو والآصال﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ظلالهم is conjoined to ﴿مَن﴾; ﴿بالغدو والآصال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يسجد﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿قل من رب السماوات والأرض قل الله﴾: قل is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; the clause after it is the speech reported by the verb "say" (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿مَن﴾ is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿رب السماوات والأرض﴾ is the khabar (predicate); قل is an imperative verb; ﴿الله﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "هو الله", or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "Allah is the Lord of the heavens and the earth".
﴿قل أفاتخذتم من دونه أولياء لا يملكون لأنفسهم نفعا ولا ضرا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval and mockery (istifhām inkārī tahakkumī); the فاء conjoins to something omitted, the implied form being: "Say: did you acknowledge the aforementioned answer and then take…?"; ﴿اتخذتم﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); أولياء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause لا يملكون is an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿لأنفسهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl, or attached to "benefit" and "harm" on the basis that they are maṣdars (verbal nouns); ﴿نفعًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and ﴿ولا ضرًّا﴾ is conjoined to it.
﴿قل هل يستوي الأعمى والبصير أم هل تستوي الظلمات والنور﴾: هل is an interrogative particle in the sense of negation, i.e. "they are not equal"; يستوي الأعمى is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; أم: a conjunction, and it is disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), meaning بل (rather) only, which is the preferred view; it is also said to be construed as meaning بل together with the interrogative hamza. ﴿هل تستوي الظلمات والنور﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿أم جعلوا لله شركاء خلقوا كخلقه فتشابه الخلق عليهم﴾: أم: disconnected, meaning بل together with the interrogative hamza, the implied form being "بل أجعلوا ..." (rather, did they make…); جعلوا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; شركاء is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause خلقوا is an adjective; ﴿كخلقه﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "they created a creation like His creation"; ﴿خلقه﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi, and the هاء is a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the فاء is a conjunction; تشابه الخلق is a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تشابه﴾.
﴿قل الله خالق كل شيء وهو الواحد القهار﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and خالق كل شيء the khabar; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, الواحد the khabar, and القهار a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿أنزل من السماء ماء فسالت أودية بقدرها﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أنزل is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah the Exalted; ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل; ماء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the فاء is a conjunction; سالت أودية is a verb and its fāʿil; بقدرها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿سالت﴾, or to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أودية.
﴿فاحتمل السيل زبدا رابيا﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; احتمل السيل is a past verb and its fāʿil; زبدًا is the object of احتمل, and رابيًا is an adjective of ﴿زبدًا﴾.
﴿ومما يوقدون عليه في النار ابتغاء حلية أو متاع زبد مثله﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); the clause يوقدون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يوقدون﴾; ﴿في النار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ابتغاء حلية is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); it is also said to be a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of a ḥāl, i.e. "seeking ornaments"; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, and متاع is conjoined to حلية; زبد is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿مثله﴾ is an adjective.
﴿كذلك يضرب الله الحق والباطل﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "with a striking like that wonderful striking Allah strikes the similitude of truth and falsehood"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; ﴿يضرب الله الحق﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; الباطل is conjoined to الحق.
﴿فأما الزبد فيذهب جفاء﴾: the فاء is a conjunction for ramification (tafrīʿ); أما is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); الزبد is a mubtadaʾ; the فاء is linking; the clause يذهب is the khabar; جفاء is a ḥāl.
﴿وأما ما ينفع الناس فيمكث في الأرض﴾: the واو is a conjunction; أما is a particle of condition and detailing; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ; the clause ينفع الناس is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the فاء is linking; the clause يمكث في الأرض is the khabar.
﴿كذلك يضرب الله الأمثال﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "with a striking like that striking Allah strikes the similitudes"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; ﴿يضرب الله الأمثال﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿للذين استجابوا لربهم الحسنى﴾: ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); the clause استجابوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿لربهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿استجابوا﴾; الحسنى is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); or ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يضرب﴾ in the preceding ayah, and الحسنى is an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "the fairest response".
﴿والذين لم يستجيبوا له لو أن لهم ما في الأرض جميعا ومثله معه لافتدوا به﴾: الذين is a mubtadaʾ, and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position, its khabar being لو and what falls in its scope; or it is conjoined by coordination to the preceding الذين; the clause لم يستجيبوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يستجيبوا﴾; لو is conditional; أن together with what falls in its scope is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is the khabar of إن [Translator's note: i.e. of أنّ], and ﴿ما﴾ is its noun; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿ومثله﴾ is conjoined; ﴿معه﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "being with it"; ﴿لافتدوا﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of لو; افتدوا is a past verb, and the واو is the fāʿil; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿افتدوا﴾.
﴿أولئك لهم سوء الحساب ومأواهم جهنم وبئس المهاد﴾: أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; سوء الحساب is the delayed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك; مأواهم is a mubtadaʾ, and جهنم is the khabar of مأواهم; ﴿بئس﴾ is a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; المهاد is the fāʿil; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "their bed", or "it".

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿أفمن يعلم أنما أنزل إليك من ربك الحق كمن هو أعمى﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); the فاء is delayed from an earlier position, or it conjoins to something omitted which is what the hamza enters upon, the implied form being: "Are the believer and the unbeliever equal? Is then the one who knows…?"; ﴿مَن﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يعلم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; أنما is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); أنزل is a past verb in the passive (built on the form whose agent is not named); ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل; الحق is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); or ﴿ما﴾ is separated, so that أن is parsed as an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ما its noun and الحق its khabar (predicate); on both construals, أن together with what falls in its scope takes the place of the two objects of يعلم; ﴿كمن﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and مَن is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and أعمى the khabar, and the nominal clause is the ṣila of مَن, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنما يتذكر أولوا الألباب﴾: إنما is a restraining particle and the restrained one; يتذكر is an imperfect verb; أولو is its fāʿil (agent), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the واو, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; الألباب is the muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿الله الذي رفع السماوات بغير عمد ترونها﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿الذي﴾ its khabar (predicate), or an adjective (ṣifa) with the khabar coming later; the clause رفع السماوات is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿بغير عمد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿السماوات﴾, i.e. "He raised them free of pillars"; the clause ترونها is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or accusative as a ḥāl from السماوات, i.e. "visible to you", or an adjective of ﴿عمد﴾ if the pronoun refers to them; and the whole clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ثم استوى على العرش وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري لأجل مسمى﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay; استوى is a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); ﴿على العرش﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿استوى﴾; سخر الشمس والقمر is conjoined to استوى; كل is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يجري is the khabar; ﴿لأجل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يجري﴾; مسمى is an adjective.
﴿يدبر الأمر يفصل الآيات لعلكم بلقاء ربكم توقنون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or the khabar of ﴿الله﴾ according to what has preceded; ﴿يدبر الأمر﴾ is an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يفصل الآيات is conjoined; لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the كاف is its noun; ﴿بلقاء ربكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿توقنون﴾; the clause توقنون is the khabar of ﴿لعلكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿الذين يوفون بعهد الله ولا ينقضون الميثاق﴾: الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is His statement ﴿أولئك لهم عقبى الدار﴾ which comes later; or it is a badal (substitute) from ﴿أولو الألباب﴾ in the preceding ayah; the clause يوفون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿بعهد الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يوفون﴾; ﴿لا ينقضون الميثاق﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿والذين يصلون ما أمر الله به أن يوصل﴾: the واو is a conjunction; الذين is conjoined to الذين; the clause يصلون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أمر الله﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the object of ﴿أمر﴾ is omitted, the implied form being "ما أمرهم" (what He commanded them); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمر﴾; أن together with what falls in its scope is a badal (substitute) from the genitive pronoun, namely the هاء, i.e. "بوصله" (its being joined).
﴿ويخشون ربهم ويخافون سوء الحساب﴾: the واو is a conjunction; يخشون is conjoined to يصلون; يخشون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and ربهم is the mafʿūl bihi; يخافون is conjoined to يخشون, and سوء الحساب is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿والذين صبروا ابتغاء وجه ربهم﴾: the واو is a conjunction; الذين is conjoined to the preceding الذين; صبروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ابتغاء وجه ربهم is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); it is also said that والذين صبروا is a resumptive sentence with no grammatical position, and it is also said that it is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿وأقاموا الصلاة وأنفقوا مما رزقناهم سرا وعلانية﴾: the واو is a conjunction, the واو is a conjunction [Translator's note: the phrase is repeated in the source]; أقاموا الصلاة is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is conjoined; ﴿وأنفقوا﴾ is conjoined to أقاموا; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنفقوا﴾; the clause رزقناهم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and it is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; سرًّا and علانية are accusative by removal of the preposition, or they are two maṣdars (verbal nouns) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "secretly and openly".
﴿ويدرءون بالحسنة السيئة﴾: conjoined to what has preceded; ﴿بالحسنة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يدرءون﴾; السيئة is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يدرءون﴾.
﴿أولئك لهم عقبى الدار﴾: أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); عقبى الدار is the delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لهم عقبى الدار﴾ is the khabar of أولئك, and the whole clause is the khabar of the first ﴿الذين﴾.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وهو الذي مد الأرض وجعل فيها رواسي وأنهارا﴾: هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and الذي its khabar (predicate); the clause مد الأرض is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿جعل﴾ is conjoined to the ṣila clause, with no grammatical position; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جعل﴾; رواسي is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and أنهارًا is conjoined to it.
﴿ومن كل الثمرات جعل فيها زوجين اثنين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جعل﴾ after them, the implied order being: "and He made in it two mates of every fruit"; or they are attached to something omitted as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from اثنين; the clause ﴿جعل فيها زوجين﴾ is conjoined to the ṣila clause, with no grammatical position; or the sentence is complete at His words ﴿من كل الثمرات﴾, so that it is attached to the first ﴿جعل﴾, the implied sense being: "that He made in the earth such and such, and of every fruit"; on this construal the clause ﴿جعل فيها زوجين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جعل﴾; زوجين is the object of ﴿جعل﴾, and ﴿اثنين﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿زوجين﴾.
﴿يغشي الليل النهار﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of the verbs before it; the fāʿil of ﴿يغشي﴾ is latent (mustatir); الليل is the first object and النهار the second object.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يتفكرون﴾: إن and its advanced khabar; ﴿لآيات﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis, and آيات is the delayed noun of إن; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿آيات﴾; the clause يتفكرون is an adjective of قوم.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وفي الأرض قطع متجاورات﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); قطع is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and متجاورات is an adjective (ṣifa) of قطع.
﴿وجنات من أعناب وزرع ونخيل صنوان وغير صنوان﴾: the واو is a conjunction; جنات is conjoined to قطع; ﴿من أعناب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective; زرع and نخيل are also conjoined; صنوان is an adjective of نخيل; ﴿غير﴾ is conjoined, and صنوان is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿يسقى بماء واحد ونفضل بعضها على بعض في الأكل﴾: the clause يسقى is an adjective of جنات and what follows it; ﴿بماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يسقى﴾; ﴿واحد﴾ is an adjective of ماء; نفضل بعضها is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على بعض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نفضل; ﴿في الأكل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿بعضها﴾, i.e. "We prefer some of them as something eaten", or: "and in it is the produce", or they are attached to نفضل.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يعقلون﴾: إن and its advanced khabar; ﴿لآيات﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis, and آيات is the delayed noun of إن; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of آيات; the clause يعقلون is an adjective of قوم.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿وإن تعجب فعجب قولهم﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; تعجب is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت" (you, O Muḥammad); the فاء is linking; عجب is the advanced khabar (predicate), and ﴿قولهم﴾ the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿فعجب قولهم﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the jussive-governing condition.
﴿أئذا كنا ترابا﴾: this clause is speech reported (maqūl) by the "saying", and it is a badal (substitute) from it; the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); إذا is an adverb for future time, putting its protasis in the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis; or ﴿إذا﴾ is purely adverbial, without any conditional meaning; ﴿كنا﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and ترابًا is its khabar.
﴿أئنا لفي خلق جديد﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في خلق﴾ is the khabar of إن; جديد is an adjective (ṣifa) of خلق.
﴿أولئك الذين كفروا بربهم﴾: أولئك is the mubtadaʾ and الذين its khabar; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿بربهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿كفروا﴾.
﴿وأولئك الأغلال في أعناقهم﴾: the واو is a conjunction; أولئك is a mubtadaʾ, الأغلال is a second mubtadaʾ, and ﴿في أعناقهم﴾ is the khabar of الأغلال; the second mubtadaʾ with its khabar is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ.
﴿وأولئك أصحاب النار هم فيها خالدون﴾: the واو is a conjunction; أولئك is a mubtadaʾ and أصحاب النار its khabar; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خالدون﴾; خالدون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; the clause ﴿هم فيها خالدون﴾ is a second khabar of أولئك, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿ويستعجلونك بالسيئة قبل الحسنة﴾: the واو is a conjunction; يستعجلونك is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بالسيئة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستعجلونك﴾.
﴿وقد خلت من قبلهم المثلات﴾: the واو is for the ḥāl (circumstantial); قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); خلت is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خلت; المثلات is the fāʿil of خلت.
﴿وإن ربك لذو مغفرة للناس على ظلمهم﴾: the واو is also for the ḥāl; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ربك is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ذو مغفرة is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مغفرة﴾; ﴿على ظلمهم﴾ is a ḥāl from الناس, the meaning being: "wronging themselves".
﴿وإن ربك لشديد العقاب﴾: the واو is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle, and ربك is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām; شديد العقاب is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿ويقول الذين كفروا لولا أنزل عليه آية من ربه﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿يقول الذين﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) meaning هلا (why not); أنزل is a past verb in the passive (built on the form whose agent is not named); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزل﴾; آية is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿من ربه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of آية.
﴿إنما أنت منذر ولكل قوم هاد﴾: إنما is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); أنت is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and منذر the khabar (predicate); ﴿لكل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; قوم is the muḍāf ilayhi; هاد is the delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿إنما نت منذر﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, a typographical slip for ﴿إنما أنت منذر﴾] is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿الله يعلم ما تحمل كل أنثى﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يعلم is the khabar (predicate); the fāʿil (agent) of يعلم is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the object of يعلم; the clause ﴿تحمل كل أنثى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "تحمله" (she carries it); or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and together with what it enters upon is the object of يعلم, so the clause after it has no grammatical position and no returning pronoun is needed; or ﴿ما﴾ is interrogative, either a mubtadaʾ with the clause ﴿تحمل﴾ as its khabar, or an advanced object of ﴿تحمل﴾.
﴿وما تغيض الأرحام وما تزداد﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿وكل شيء عنده بمقدار﴾: كل is a mubtadaʾ, and شيء is the muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿عنده﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of شيء, or of كل; ﴿بمقدار﴾ is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿عالم الغيب والشهادة الكبير المتعال﴾: عالم الغيب is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "هو"; الغيب is the muḍāf ilayhi, and الشهادة is conjoined; الكبير is a second khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ, and المتعال a third khabar.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿جنات عدن يدخلونها ومن صلح من آبائهم وأزواجهم وذرياتهم﴾: ﴿جنات عدن﴾ is a badal (substitute) from ﴿عقبى الدار﴾, or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are gardens", and the clause ﴿يدخلونها﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; or ﴿جنات عدن﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and the clause ﴿يدخلونها﴾ its khabar. ﴿ومَن﴾ is conjoined to the واو in يدخلونها, or it is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), the واو being the واو of accompaniment; the clause ﴿صلح﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿من آبائهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl, and what follows it is conjoined to it.
﴿والملائكة يدخلون عليهم من كل باب﴾: the واو is for the ḥāl; الملائكة is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يدخلون is the khabar; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يدخلون﴾, and ﴿من كل باب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to ﴿يدخلون﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿سلام عليكم بما صبرتم فنعم عقبى الدار﴾: سلام is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is the speech reported by an omitted verb of saying, and the omitted clause of saying is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "saying"; ﴿بما صبرتم﴾: the باء is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the باء; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هذا بما صبرتم", i.e. "this is because of your patience", or they are attached to سلام; the فاء is the فاء of eloquence (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); ﴿نعم﴾ is a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise; عقبى الدار is the fāʿil (agent) of نعم; the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. "هي" (it).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿والذين ينقضون عهد الله من بعد ميثاقه﴾: الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ينقضون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the واو is the fāʿil (agent), and عهد الله the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من بعد ميثاقه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويقطعون ما أمر الله به أن يوصل﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause أمر الله is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the object of أمر is omitted, the implied form being "ما أمرهم" (what He commanded them); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أمر; أن together with what falls in its scope is a badal (substitute) from the genitive pronoun, namely the هاء, i.e. "بوصله" (its being joined).
﴿ويفسدون في الأرض﴾: conjoined to the preceding clauses.
﴿أولئك لهم اللعنة ولهم سوء الدار﴾: أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿لهم اللعنة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); اللعنة is the delayed mubtadaʾ; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted, advanced khabar; the clause أولئك لهم اللعنة is the khabar of ﴿الذين﴾; ﴿لهم سوء الدار﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لهم اللعنة﴾.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يبسط الرزق is the khabar (predicate); ﴿لمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبسط﴾; the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; يقدر is conjoined to يشاء.
﴿وفرحوا بالحياة الدنيا﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿بالحياة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿فرحوا﴾; الدنيا is an adjective (ṣifa) of الحياة.
﴿وما الحياة الدنيا في الآخرة إلا متاع﴾: the واو is for the ḥāl (circumstantial); ما is negative; الحياة is a mubtadaʾ and الدنيا an adjective; ﴿في الآخرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, with a muḍāf omitted, the implied form being: "and the life of this world, being beside the Hereafter, is not…"; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); متاع is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ويقول الذين كفروا لولا أنزل عليه آية من ربه﴾: the واو is a conjunction; يقول الذين is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), equivalent to هلا (why not); أنزل is a past verb in the passive (built on the form whose agent is not named); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزل﴾, and the pronoun refers to the Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ; آية is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿من ربه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa).
﴿قل إن الله يضل من يشاء ويهدي إليه من أناب﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause يضل is its khabar (predicate); ﴿مَن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يشاء is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; يهدي is conjoined to يضل; ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يهدي﴾; ﴿مَن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause أناب is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿الذين آمنوا وتطمئن قلوبهم بذكر الله ألا بذكر الله تطمئن القلوب﴾: الذين is a badal (substitute) from ﴿مَن أناب﴾ in the preceding ayah, or an explication (bayān) of it; the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. Or الذين is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are those who believed", or it is accusative by way of praise; قلوبهم is the fāʿil (agent) of تطمئن; ﴿بذكر الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تطمئن﴾; القلوب is a fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات طوبى لهم﴾: الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; عملوا الصالحات is conjoined to the ṣila, with no grammatical position; طوبى is a mubtadaʾ, and ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); it is also said that طوبى is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the lām in ﴿لهم﴾ being for clarification (bayān); the clause ﴿طوبى لهم﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿الذين﴾.
﴿وحسن مآب﴾: ﴿وحسن﴾ is conjoined to ﴿طوبى﴾, and مآب is the muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿كذلك أرسلناك في أمة قد خلت من قبلها أمم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "with a sending like that great sending We have sent you"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; ﴿أرسلناك﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في أمة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلناك﴾; the clause قد خلت is an adjective of ﴿أمة﴾; ﴿من قبلها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); أمم is the fāʿil.
﴿وهم يكفرون بالرحمن﴾: the واو is for the ḥāl, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يكفرون﴾; or the واو is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قل هو ربي﴾: ﴿هو ربي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is the speech reported by the verb "say" (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) from the position of لا and its noun, whose position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal from the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar.
﴿عليه توكلت وإليه متاب﴾: ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿توكلت﴾; ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar, and متاب is the delayed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿ولو أن قرآنا سيرت به الجبال أو قطعت به الأرض أو كلم به الموتى﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لو is conditional; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), قرآنًا is its noun, and the clause سيرت is the khabar (predicate) of أن; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سيرت﴾; الجبال is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; قطعت به الأرض is conjoined; ﴿كلم به الموتى﴾ is also conjoined; the answer of لو is omitted, its implied form being "لما آمنوا" (they would not have believed), or "لكان هذا القرآن" (it would have been this Qurʾān).
﴿بل لله الأمر جميعا﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; الأمر is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أفلم ييأس الذين آمنوا أن لو يشاء الله لهدى الناس جميعا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and affirmation (taqrīr); لم is a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; ييأس is an imperfect verb made jussive by ﴿لم﴾; الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; أن is lightened from the heavy (أنّ), and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); ﴿لو﴾ is a conditional particle; يشاء is an imperfect verb and ﴿الله﴾ its fāʿil; the lām is linking; the clause هدى الناس is the answer of ﴿لو﴾, with no grammatical position; جميعًا is a ḥāl; the conditional clause and its answer are the khabar of أن.
﴿ولا يزال الذين كفروا تصيبهم بما صنعوا قارعة﴾: the واو is a conjunction; لا يزال is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating imperfect verb; الذين is its noun; the clause كفروا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause تصيبهم is the khabar of ﴿لا يزال﴾; ﴿بما صنعوا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تصيبهم﴾, i.e. "because of what they did", so the باء is causal and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; قارعة is the fāʿil of تصيبهم.
﴿أو تحل قريبا من دارهم﴾: أو is a conjunction; تحل is conjoined to تصيبهم, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هي", i.e. the calamity; قريبًا is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), i.e. "a place near their abode"; ﴿من دارهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قريبًا﴾. It is also said that the fāʿil of ﴿تحل﴾ refers to the one addressed, namely the Messenger ﷺ, i.e. "you alight with your army near their abode", as he alighted at al-Ḥudaybiya, and the conquest of Mecca came.
﴿حتى يأتي وعد الله إن الله لا يخلف الميعاد﴾: حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive; يأتي is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from the implied أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تصيبهم﴾; وعد الله is the fāʿil; إن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, the clause لا يخلف is its khabar, and الميعاد is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك﴾: the واو is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); استهزئ is a past verb in the passive (built on the form whose agent is not named); ﴿برسل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that takes the place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿من قبلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿استهزئ﴾, or to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿رسل﴾.
﴿فأمليت للذين كفروا ثم أخذتهم فكيف كان عقاب﴾: the فاء is for conjunction; أمليت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أمليت﴾; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ثم is a conjunction; أخذتهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فكيف﴾: the فاء is a conjunction, and كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the advanced khabar (predicate) of كان; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and ﴿عقاب﴾ is its noun.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿أفمن هو قائم على كل نفس بما كسبت﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and its answer is omitted, its implied form being "No"; the فاء conjoins to something omitted; ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿هو﴾ is a second mubtadaʾ, and قائم is the khabar (predicate) of the second mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿على كل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قائم﴾; the باء is a preposition meaning مع (with); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the genitive by the باء, or maṣdariyya, and together with what it enters upon it is genitive by the باء; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the khabar of من is omitted, its implied form being: "like one who is not so, of their partners that neither harm nor benefit", and His statement after it, ﴿جعلوا لله شركاء﴾, indicates it.
﴿وجعلوا لله شركاء﴾: the واو is for resumption, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or it is a conjunction, or for the ḥāl; جعلوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جعلوا﴾ or to an omitted ḥāl; شركاء is the object of جعلوا.
﴿قل سموهم أم تنبئونه بما لا يعلم في الأرض﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); سموهم: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أم: disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), construed as ﴿بل وهمزة الاستفهام﴾ (rather, plus the interrogative hamza), the implied form being: "Rather, do you inform Him of partners whom He does not know in the earth?", the interrogation being for rebuke; تنبئونه is an imperfect verb from which the interrogative hamza has been dropped, the implied form being "أتنبئونه؟", and it is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تنبئونه﴾; the clause لا يعلم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the object of يعلم is omitted, i.e. "يعلمه" (He knows it); ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿أم بظاهر من القول﴾: أم: disconnected, meaning بل plus the interrogative hamza, the implied form being: "Rather, do you name them partners by mere outward speech, without there being any reality to that?"; it is also said that ﴿أم﴾ is connected (muttaṣila), the implied form being: "or do you inform Him by outward speech that has no reality?". ﴿بظاهر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تنبئونه﴾, and ﴿من القول﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ظاهر﴾.
﴿بل زين للذين كفروا مكرهم﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; زين is a past verb in the passive (built on the form whose agent is not named); ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿زين﴾; كفروا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; مكرهم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿وصدوا عن السبيل﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿صدوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿عن السبيل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿صدوا﴾.
﴿ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿مَن﴾ is conditional, in the position of accusative as the advanced mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يضلل﴾; يضلل is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿فما﴾: the فاء links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; ﴿مِن﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; ﴿هاد﴾ is the delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative by position and genitive in form by ﴿مِن﴾.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿لهم عذاب في الحياة الدنيا﴾: ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); عذاب is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿في الحياة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب; الدنيا is an adjective of الحياة.
﴿ولعذاب الآخرة أشق﴾: the واو is a conjunction, or for the ḥāl (circumstantial); the lām is for inception (ibtidāʾ); الآخرة is the muḍāf ilayhi; أشق is the khabar of عذاب.
﴿وما لهم من الله من واق﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ما is negative; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿واق﴾; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); ﴿واق﴾ is genitive in form and nominative by position, because it is the delayed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿مثل الجنة التي وعد المتقون تجري من تحتها الأنهار أكلها دائم وظلها﴾: ﴿مثل الجنة﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted; ﴿التي﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of الجنة; ﴿وعد المتقون﴾ is a past verb in the passive (built on the form whose agent is not named) and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause ﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); it is also said to be resumptive, and so to have no grammatical position. Likewise the clause ﴿أكلها دائم﴾: أكلها is a mubtadaʾ and دائم the khabar; ظلها is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "دائم" (lasting).
﴿تلك عقبى الذين اتقوا﴾: ﴿تلك﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and عقبى the khabar; ﴿الذين﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi; the clause اتقوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿وعقبى الكافرين النار﴾: عقبى is the mubtadaʾ and النار the khabar, or the reverse.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿والذين آتيناهم الكتاب يفرحون بما أنزل إليك﴾: الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿آتيناهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; الكتاب is the second object of آتيناهم; the clause يفرحون is the khabar (predicate) of الذين; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفرحون﴾; the clause أنزل إليك is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن الأحزاب من ينكر بعضه﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿من الأحزاب﴾ is the advanced khabar; ﴿مَن﴾ is the delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause ينكر is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; بعضه is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قل إنما أمرت أن أعبد الله﴾: إنما is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); أمرت is a past verb in the passive (built on the form whose agent is not named), and the تاء is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); أن together with what falls in its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "بأن أعبد الله" (to worship Allah), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أمرت﴾.
﴿ولا أشرك به إليه أدعو وإليه مآب﴾: the واو is a conjunction; لا أشرك is conjoined to ﴿أن أعبد﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أشرك﴾; ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أدعو﴾; the second ﴿إليه﴾ is the advanced khabar [Translator's note: the source has مخبر, evidently a slip for خبر]; مآب is the delayed mubtadaʾ, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the first-person ياء, which is dropped to observe the verse endings (fawāṣil).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿وكذلك أنزلناه حكما عربيا﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "with a sending-down like that We have sent it down"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; أنزلناه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حكمًا and عربيًّا are two ḥāls (circumstantials), i.e. "judging between people, in Arabic".
﴿ولئن اتبعت أهواءهم بعد ما جاءك من العلم﴾: the lām paves the way for the oath (mūṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); إن is conditional; اتبعت is a verb and its fāʿil, and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); أهواءهم is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بعد﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اتبعت﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the muḍāf ilayhi; the clause جاءك is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿من العلم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ما لك من الله من ولي ولا واق﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿واق﴾; ﴿من ولي﴾: ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿ولي﴾ is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative by position and genitive in form by ﴿مِن﴾; ﴿ولا واق﴾ is conjoined to وليّ; the clause ﴿ما لك﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿ولقد أرسلنا رسلا من قبلك﴾: the واو is for resumption, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the واو is for the oath; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿أرسلنا﴾ is the answer to the oath; رسلا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من قبلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾.
﴿وجعلنا لهم أزواجا وذرية﴾: the واو is a conjunction; جعلنا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جعل﴾; أزواجًا is the first object; ذرية is conjoined to ﴿أزواجًا﴾.
﴿وما كان لرسول أن يأتي بآية إلا بإذن الله﴾: the واو is a conjunction; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; ﴿لرسول﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted, advanced khabar (predicate) of كان; أن together with what falls in its scope is its delayed noun; ﴿بآية﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأتي﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿بإذن الله﴾ is an exception from the most general of states, so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لكل أجل كتاب﴾: ﴿لكل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; أجل is the muḍāf ilayhi; كتاب is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿يمحو الله ما يشاء ويثبت وعنده أم الكتاب﴾: يمحو الله is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; يثبت is conjoined to يمحو; ﴿عنده﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); ﴿أمّ﴾ is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and الكتاب is muḍāf [Translator's note: so in the source; الكتاب is the muḍāf ilayhi].

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿وإن ما نرينك بعض الذي نعدهم أو نتوفينك فإنما عليك البلاغ وعلينا الحساب﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the conditional إن is assimilated into ﴿ما﴾, and ﴿ما﴾ here is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); نرينك is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its connection to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and بعض the second object; الذي is the muḍāf ilayhi; the clause نعدهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; نتوفينك is conjoined to نرينك; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "then that suffices you and is a proof of your truthfulness", and the فاء in His words ﴿فإنما﴾ gives the reason for this omitted part; it is also said that ﴿فإنما﴾ is the apodosis; إنما is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate), and البلاغ is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar, and الحساب is the delayed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿أولم يروا أنا نأتي الأرض ننقصها من أطرافها﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); the واو conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being: "Do they deny the coming of what We threatened them with?"; لم is a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause نأتي is the khabar (predicate) of أن; أن with its noun and khabar takes the place of the two objects of يروا; the fāʿil (agent) of نأتي is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; الأرض is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ننقصها من أطرافها is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of نأتي or from its object.
﴿والله يحكم﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يحكم is the khabar.
﴿لا معقب لحكمه وهو سريع الحساب﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation; معقب is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; ﴿لحكمه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of ﴿لا﴾; ﴿وهو﴾: the واو is a conjunction, ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and سريع الحساب is the khabar of ﴿هو﴾; the clause ﴿لا معقب لحكمه﴾ is also a ḥāl from the fāʿil of نأتي by way of a shift of person (iltifāt), as though it were said: "and Allah judges, His judgement being executed".

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿وقد مكر الذين من قبلهم﴾: the واو is resumptive; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); the clause مكر الذين من قبلهم is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فلله المكر جميعا﴾: the فاء conjoins to something omitted, serving as a statement of reason, i.e. "so pay no heed to their plotting"; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); المكر is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يعلم ما تكسب كل نفس﴾: يعلم is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿تكسب﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿كل نفس﴾ is the fāʿil.
﴿وسيعلم الكفار لمن عقبى الدار﴾: the سين is for the future; ﴿يعلم الكفار﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿لمن﴾: the lām is a preposition, and ﴿مَن﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; عقبى الدار is the delayed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿ويقول الذين كفروا لست مرسلا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿لست﴾ is an abrogating past verb, the تاء is its noun, and مرسلا is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿لست مرسلا﴾ is the speech reported by their saying (maqūl qawlihim).
﴿قل كفى بالله شهيدا بيني وبينكم ومن عنده علم الكتاب﴾: كفى is a past verb; ﴿بالله﴾: the باء is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and the Name of Majesty is genitive in form, nominative by position; شهيدًا is a tamyīz (specification); ﴿بيني وبينكم﴾ are two adverbs attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿شهيدًا﴾; ﴿ومَن﴾ is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾; ﴿عنده﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; علم الكتاب is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
